name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings.

name: Alert
description: Displays important messages to the user.

name: Alert Dialog
description: A modal dialog for important alerts requiring confirmation.

name: Animated Counter
description: Counting or rolling to a new value, in the reader’s language; motion only where it is used.

name: Area Chart
description: Series as areas, filled down to 0 or stacked — to 100% if you like — with natural, linear, step or monotone edges; gradients of your own.

name: Aspect Ratio
description: Displays content within a fixed aspect ratio.

name: Attachment
description: Show a file alongside its upload state, on its own or in a scrollable row.

name: Audio Player
description: An audio player: a playlist, a waveform, controls as parts, state two ways, keyboard shortcuts.

name: Autocomplete
description: An input with autocomplete suggestions.

name: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing users.

name: Backdrop
description: A dimmed, blurred layer that fades in and out behind an overlay.

name: Badge
description: Displays a small status indicator or label.

name: Bar Chart
description: Series as bars: side by side, stacked, below 0; each corner's radius of your choice.

name: Barcode Scanner
description: Camera or picture, codes outlined, states, torch and cameras; the standard BarcodeDetector.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Displays the path to the current resource.

name: Bubble
description: A single message in a conversation, aligned to either side and optionally carrying reactions.

name: Button
description: A clickable button with multiple variants.

name: Button Group
description: Groups buttons together with merged borders and rounding.

name: Button Pattern
description: A directive that adds button behavior to non-button elements.

name: Calendar
description: Days, months and years in your language; one, several or a range; the keyboard across months; a form field.

name: Card
description: A container for grouping related content.

name: Carousel
description: A slideshow for cycling through elements.

name: Chart
description: The parts every chart is made of, as shadcn/ui's: rows and series' names and colors, a plot with its grid, axes and cursor, a tooltip and a legend.

name: Checkbox
description: A control for toggling a single option on or off.

name: Code Editor
description: Code to edit: CodeMirror, colored by Shiki; a form field.

name: Code Block
description: Code to read and copy: highlighted, numbered, its lines marked.

name: Collapsible
description: An interactive component that expands and collapses.

name: Color Picker
description: A color picker: area and channel sliders with alpha, any CSS colour in, swatches, hex/rgb/hsl/oklch out; a form field.

name: Combobox
description: An autocomplete input with filtering.

name: Command
description: A command palette for quick actions and search.

name: Compare
description: Two things compared, split by a divider: photos before and after, two themes, any content.

name: Confetti
description: A burst, two cannons or fireworks in the theme’s colours; canvas-confetti only where it is used.

name: Context Menu
description: A menu displayed on right-click.

name: Copy to Clipboard
description: A composable directive for copying text to the clipboard with visual feedback.

name: Countdown
description: To a moment or a pausable timer, on the second, units in the app's language, rolling digits and a ring.

name: Data Table
description: Styled, accessible parts for TanStack Table data tables.

name: Date Input
description: A date typed as text, or part by part, in your language; a form field.

name: Date Picker
description: A date picked in the calendar or typed, written in your language; a form field.

name: Date Range Picker
description: The date picker in range mode, with presets, typed ends and Apply.

name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content.

name: Diff Viewer
description: Two texts compared, line by line and word by word: split or unified, highlighted.

name: Dock
description: Your links and buttons, magnified by distance to the pointer and on focus; labels, counts, dots.

name: Drawer
description: A touch-friendly drawer that slides from the bottom.

name: Editor
description: Composable WYSIWYG editor with customizable toolbar.

name: Emoji Picker
description: A picker for selecting emojis.

name: Empty
description: Placeholder for empty content.

name: Field
description: A flexible field composition system for building accessible forms.

name: File Upload
description: Files picked or dropped, as a File[] for Signal Forms; rejections with their reason.

name: Focus Trap
description: A directive that keeps focus inside an element while it is shown, and gives it back when it goes.

name: Funnel Chart
description: A series as stages, top to bottom, each as wide as its value, narrowing to the next.

name: Hotkey
description: A directive that runs an action on a keyboard shortcut and writes the shortcut for the platform.

name: Hover Card
description: A card that appears when hovering over an element.

name: Image Annotator
description: Annotate an image: shapes over it — selected, moved, resized, restyled — with keyboard, kept as data, exported as an image.

name: Image Cropper
description: Crop an image: a box over it or a frame it moves under, with keyboard, pinch and wheel, the crop as a file.

name: Infinite Scroll
description: More near the end or the start, with whatever scrolls; a Load more button and a status.

name: Input
description: A text input field for user data entry.

name: Input Button
description: A button styled to look like an input field, useful as a trigger for search dialogs or command palettes.

name: Input Group
description: A composable input group for combining inputs with addons, buttons, and text.

name: Intersection Observer
description: A signal-based directive that tracks when an element enters or leaves the viewport or a scroll container.

name: Item
description: A flexible layout component for displaying structured content.

name: Kanban Board
description: Your items by column, dragged by any pointer or moved by the keyboard, announced in your words.

name: Kbd
description: Displays keyboard shortcuts and keys.

name: Label
description: Renders an accessible label for form controls.

name: Lightbox
description: A gallery of links opened in the native dialog, the thumbnail morphing in; zoom, pan, swipes, keys.

name: Line Chart
description: Series as lines through their values: natural, linear, step or monotone; dots if you like.

name: Link
description: A styled anchor element with button variants.

name: Marker
description: Label a point in a list or feed: a date divider, an unread boundary, or a short inline note.

name: Marquee
description: Content written once and repeated to fill, speed in px/s, four directions, pauses for hover, focus and a button; still for reduced motion.

name: Masonry Grid
description: Columns by width, the source order kept, re-laid out on any size change, spans, animated moves; native where possible.

name: Mention Input
description: A textarea with inline mention suggestions triggered by a configurable character.

name: Menu
description: Displays a menu with a list of actions or options.

name: Menu Bar
description: A horizontal menu bar with keyboard navigation support.

name: Message
description: A row in a conversation: an avatar beside a column of bubbles, with an optional header and footer.

name: Message Scroller
description: A conversation that scrolls itself: opens at the end, holds a new turn near the top, follows the end, keeps your place.

name: Multiselect
description: A select component for multiple selections.

name: Native Dialog
description: A modal dialog built on the native HTML dialog element.

name: Native Select
description: A styled native select element with a custom chevron icon.

name: Navbar
description: A responsive navigation bar with mobile menu support.

name: Navigation Menu
description: A navigation menu with links and dropdowns.

name: Notification Center
description: Notifications you put together from parts: by day, titled in your language, with an unread count for the bell.

name: Number Field
description: A number input: typed and read in the locale, stepped with the keyboard, buttons, the wheel or by dragging its label.

name: Org Chart
description: Your people as nested lists, laid out as a chart and joined by lines; a tree for the keyboard.

name: OTP Field
description: An input for entering one-time passwords.

name: Pagination
description: Navigation controls for paging through content.

name: Password
description: A composable password input with visibility toggle.

name: PDF Viewer
description: Document viewer with navigation and zoom controls.

name: Phone Input
description: An input for international phone numbers.

name: Pie Chart
description: A series as slices of a whole, each in its category's color: a pie, a donut with your text in its center, rings.

name: Popover
description: Displays floating content in relation to a trigger.

name: Progress
description: Displays an indicator showing completion progress.

name: Progress Next
description: A task's progress as a bar or a circle, named and read out, or not known yet.

name: QR Code
description: Generate and display QR codes.

name: Query Param State
description: Type-safe, signal-based URL query parameter state management inspired by nuqs.

name: Questionnaire
description: Questions one at a time on your Signal Form: checked before moving on, skipped when optional, picked by keys.

name: Radar Chart
description: Series as polygons over the categories, each on its spoke: filled or outlined, with dots, on a polygon or circle grid.

name: Radial Chart
description: A series as radial bars: a ring per row, its value as an arc — on a track, stacked, on a half circle with your text in its center.

name: Radio Group
description: A group of radio buttons for single selection.

name: Range Slider
description: A dual-thumb range slider for selecting a numeric range between a minimum and maximum value.

name: Rating
description: A composable rating component for feedback and reviews.

name: Resizable
description: A component that can be resized by dragging.

name: Sankey Chart
description: Flows between nodes, each as thick as its value, the nodes in columns.

name: Scatter Chart
description: Points at two values, x and y — sized by a third: a bubble chart.

name: Scheduler
description: Events in month, week and day views, built from parts: overlapping events side by side, all-day events, now.

name: Scroll Area
description: A scrollable area with thin, styled scrollbars that appear on hover.

name: Select
description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from — mimics a native select.

name: Select On Focus
description: A directive that automatically selects input text on programmatic focus.

name: Separator
description: Visually separates content with a line.

name: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

name: Sidebar
description: A collapsible side navigation panel.

name: Signature Pad
description: A signature pad: pressure ink, drawn or typed, a value to store and redraw, trimmed PNG and SVG export.

name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder to show while content is loading.

name: Slider
description: A styled native range input for selecting a value within a given range.

name: Sortable List
description: Your array reordered by any pointer or the keyboard, announced in your words; down, along, or as a grid.

name: Speed Dial
description: A floating button opening a menu of actions, in a line or on an arc, with a backdrop.

name: Spinner
description: A loading indicator animation.

name: Spotlight
description: One element lit, your content in a native dialog; modal, or interactive through the cutout.

name: Auth Layout
description: A page frame for sign-in pages: the routed page, alone.

name: Sidebar Layout
description: A page frame: a sidebar beside the routed page.

name: Stacked Layout
description: A page frame: a sticky navbar, the routed page and a footer.

name: Stat Card
description: A figure on a description list, formatted by Intl, its change coloured by good news.

name: Stepper
description: Guides users through a multi-step process.

name: Sunburst Chart
description: A series in two rings: its rows' groups inside, the rows around them.

name: Switch
description: A toggle control for switching between two states.

name: Table
description: A responsive table for displaying tabular data.

name: Tabs
description: Organize content into multiple sections with tabs.

name: Tags Input
description: Tags typed into one field, a string[] for Signal Forms, checked before they go in.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text input field.

name: Theme
description: Theme management with mode switching and color scheme support.

name: Time Picker
description: A time input with a list of times to pick from.

name: Time Input
description: A time typed part by part, in your language; a form field.

name: Time Clock
description: A time picked on a clock face, by pointer or keyboard.

name: Timeline
description: An ordered list, the line drawn for you, progress by status, Temporal times, alternate and horizontal.

name: Toast
description: A brief notification that appears temporarily.

name: Toggle
description: A two-state button that can be on or off.

name: Toggle Group
description: A set of toggle buttons that work together.

name: Toolbar
description: A container for grouping a set of controls, such as toggle buttons.

name: Tooltip
description: A popup that displays information on hover or focus.

name: Tour Guide
description: Steps as markup on their targets, a native modal dialog with a spotlight, flipping cards, scrolling, keys.

name: Trace
description: The steps of a run — an agent's searches, reads and commands — a line each, with a status and the output it opens on.

name: Transfer List
description: One value (the chosen ids, a form field), two listbox sides, keyboard moves, search, reorder.

name: Tree
description: A hierarchical view of nested items.

name: Treemap Chart
description: A series as boxes, each as large as its value — in groups if you like.

name: Tree Table
description: A Data Table whose rows open on their children, as a tree grid: indented, opened by the arrows, selected with their children.

name: Typography
description: Styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, and other text elements.

name: Video Player
description: A video player: controls as parts, state two ways, captions, chapters, seek preview, keyboard shortcuts.

name: Virtual List
description: Only what is seen rendered, rows measured as they render; a box or the page; down, along or in lanes.
